chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
There is no breast-feeding (creating kinship) after weaning.
ai.seo_question: Does breast-feeding after weaning create a mahram relationship in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This concise hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the temporal boundary for establishing kinship through breast-feeding (radha'), a key mechanism for creating mahram relationships in Shia fiqh. It specifies that the act must occur during the nursing period before weaning is complete, preventing ambiguity in marital prohibitions for adults who may breastfeed later in life. This ruling is foundational in distinguishing between biological and foster kinship within the family structure.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Breastfeeding after weaning is not effective/”
